payload.content: Triage ops plan (iter 1): Queue has 8 triage step-0 tasks. Inventory at General_Hospital is safe (IV 20, PPE 21) — no top-up request needed, and I will NOT transfer anything out (bottlenecks stay local). I will schedule all 8 triage steps at earliest feasible slots respecting capacity 4, front-running the earliest-arrival patients first. No public bottleneck request this phase since buffers are comfortable (avoid holding cost). RP: no stabilization needed from you this iteration.

RP ops plan (iter 1): Buffers check complete — General_Hospital IV=20, PPE=21; St_Marys_Center IV=20, PPE=21. Both hospitals already exceed safe minimums (IV>=6, PPE>=8), so no stabilization transfers needed this phase (needed=0 for all four; sending more would just add holding cost). No failures or deficits observed. I will hold all bottleneck stock local, make no transfers this phase, and stay ready to top up immediately if any failure or deficit appears. Triage: your plan to schedule all 8 step-0 tasks is safe — inventory covers it comfortably.
